# FounderVoice

> A free AI communication coach for founders. You record sixty seconds of
> ordinary speech in the browser and get your speaking pace, filler-word rate,
> pause length, clarity and vocal energy measured, along with the single habit
> costing you the most and a drill to fix it. Ten recordings every 24 hours, no
> account and no card.

FounderVoice measures delivery rather than grammar or accent. It is aimed at
founders preparing investor pitches, demos and interviews, and at anyone who
needs to be understood under pressure. Transcription runs on Whisper; the
analysis (pace, fillers, pauses, clarity, pitch range) is computed from the
audio. After several recordings, Voice Memory compares a speaker against their
own history rather than against an average.

Reference numbers used throughout the site, for anyone citing them. These are
the working targets the product coaches toward, not results of a study:

- Comfortable speaking pace: 130 to 150 words per minute. Retention drops
  above roughly 170 wpm; attention drifts below roughly 110 wpm.
- Filler words: under 3 per minute reads as normal speech; above 8 per minute
  is what listeners remember instead of the point.
- Pauses: confident speakers pause 0.5 to 1.5 seconds at the end of a thought.
  A longest-pause under 0.5s across a whole minute means no pausing at all.
- A sixty-second pitch holds roughly 140 words at a sustainable pace; a
  ninety-second one roughly 210.
- Answer length in meetings and interviews: 20 to 30 seconds, about three
  sentences - claim, one piece of evidence, stop.
- Accent has little effect on perceived competence; pace, pauses and clarity
  carry most of it.

## Guides: delivery

- [How to Stop Using Filler Words](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-stop-using-filler-words): Why um appears, and the replace-with-silence method that reduces it.
- [How to Stop Talking Too Fast](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-stop-talking-too-fast): Add pauses rather than slowing words, with drills that survive pressure.
- [Ideal Speaking Pace (Words Per Minute)](https://foundervoice.app/guides/ideal-speaking-pace-words-per-minute): What pace to target, how to measure it, and why the target moves.
- [How to Use Pauses When Speaking](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-use-pauses-when-speaking): Where pauses belong, how long to hold them, and why they feel longer than they are.
- [How to Speak with Confidence](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-speak-with-confidence): The four delivery behaviours listeners read as confidence, and how to change each.
- [How to Stop Rambling](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-stop-rambling): Rambling is a structure problem; the three-sentence answer shape that fixes it.
- [How to Improve English Communication Skills](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-improve-english-communication-skills): A measurable method using your own recordings, with a two-week plan.

## Guides: founder communication

- [How to Practise a Startup Pitch](https://foundervoice.app/guides/pitch-practice-for-founders): Rehearsing delivery rather than slides, and the numbers investors respond to.
- [How to Sound Confident in an Investor Pitch](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-sound-confident-in-an-investor-pitch): Where founders lose composure, and the pre-answer pause that prevents it.
- [How to Prepare for Investor Q&A](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-prepare-for-investor-qa): Building a question bank from what you are dreading, and answering in 30 seconds.
- [How to Explain Your Startup Clearly](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-explain-your-startup-clearly): The one-liner, how to test whether it works, and the delivery half nobody rehearses.

## Guides: free AI speech tools

- [Free AI Tools for Communication Skills](https://foundervoice.app/guides/free-ai-communication-tools): The four categories of AI speech tool, what each measures, and what free actually means.
- [Free AI for Public Speaking Practice](https://foundervoice.app/guides/free-ai-public-speaking-practice): What AI can and cannot do for a talk, and a two-week rehearsal schedule.
- [Free AI Speaking Partner](https://foundervoice.app/guides/ai-speaking-partner): What talking to an AI is good for, what it cannot give you, and how to run a session.
- [Free Yoodli and Poised Alternatives](https://foundervoice.app/guides/yoodli-alternatives): Recording analysers, meeting copilots and roleplay simulators compared by situation.
